comments.author: Randall Bohn
comments.text: Moved cal3.asm, clock.asm, fib.asm, and renamed dull-boy.asm to dullboy.asm into ./sd.

title: Fix clean target to remove bin/monitor.static
description: makefile clean target removes bin/monitor-static but the built artifact is bin/monitor.static. Update clean to remove the correct filename.

title: Decide whether to link host binaries against factory/libpdp8.so
description: bin/monitor, bin/pdp8v, and bin/pdp8-filter depend on $(FACTORY_LIB) but filter it out when linking, so they compile emulator sources directly. Clarify intent: link against shared lib or keep sources-only, and update makefile accordingly.
close_reason: Linked host binaries against factory/libpdp8.so and rebuilt.
